asciichat_error_t network_client_negotiate (acip_transport_t * transport, crypto_handshake_context_t * ctx, uint8_t mode, network_protocol_t protocol)

Drive a client wire profile using connection-owned security storage. A single absolute deadline covers negotiation; the caller retains transport and credentials until cancellation and all users have drained.
